notes.title: Update 1.2.9.0
notes.content:
We have released a new update for the game! The changes consist mostly of quality of life updates, but also include a fix for a major issue when running the game at 30 fps (for example, when in Steam Deck's 30Hz power save mode). 

Additionally, we've added some features to support the speedrunner community. These features include a fixed memory location that contains the current state of the game (to enable support for autosplitting tools) and a way to completely disable the conversation dialogs via a change in the game's setting file. 

You can discuss and learn more about these features in our [url=https://discord.gg/ariettaofspirits]Discord channel[/url].


Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fix for issues when running game at 30Hz (Steam Deck power save mode)
[*] Added support for speedrunning features
[*] Fix issue where player can get stuck when visiting Almona
[*] Italian translation fixes
[*] Fixes to pixel perfect scaling at aspect ratios other than 16:9
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.8.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35774017/d549796fa5dd4a1e9e4e47c04fb22275a19bae57.png[/img]

We've made various bug fixes and performance improvements to the game!

Here is a more detailed list of changes in this update:

[list]
[*] - Various visual and performance improvements on lower end hardware
[*] - Fixed collisions issues in Mine maps
[*] - Improvements to hit detection with Shade Roamer 
[*] - Added a warning marker to "Sunken Behemoth" Vortex attack
[*] - Fixes to depth issues with various items throughout the game
[*] - Fixed an issue where player can get stuck when talking to Almona
[*] + Other smaller quality of life updates
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update - v1.0.0.6
notes.content:
The demo has been updated. This update includes a highly requested feature; support for remappable controls, among other various bug fixes and improvements.

This will probably be the last update for the demo. We're still on track to release the full game later this year!


Join our Discord community and follow the development here:
[url=http://ariettaofspirits.com/discord]http://ariettaofspirits.com/discord[/url]
